coverage.basis: Diamond attempt, retained North CA and later controlled decision observed; gift/entry meaning requires independent review.

findings.fact: West has already played D6; the selected D5 cannot beat it.
findings.explanation: The reason describes the selected card as winning, although it is below the current winning card and East has yet to play.
quotes: Dummy should play the lowest diamond that wins the trick, preserving the king and queen to force out the ace and continue establishing the suit.

findings.fact: North holds H43 and CA10; a heart lead requires North to follow hearts.
findings.explanation: Leading H2 cannot lead toward or reach North’s club honors. The proposed explanation supplies no feasible connection to a club continuation and conflicts with the retained diamond plan.
quotes: Lead a low heart toward dummy’s ace-ten clubs; a club continuation can help establish the suit while retaining the heart honors.

findings.fact: North’s only hearts are H4 and H3; its ten is CT.
findings.explanation: The explanation treats North as having a ten or honor relevant to following hearts, although neither legal heart is an honor.
quotes: Dummy should play the lowest heart; preserve the ten and avoid spending an honor while East is still to play.

findings.fact: Defenders have four tricks; South can beat HQ with HA or HK, while North has only H4.
findings.explanation: Playing H6 concedes the setting fifth trick despite two available winners. Preserving both honors supplies no concrete compensating route and abandons the stated development plan.
quotes: Follow hearts with the six, preserving the ace and king to regain the lead later.

findings.fact: The current trick contains only East’s HT; South holds HA and HK and selects HA.
findings.explanation: HA wins this trick. The reason incorrectly declares it lost and says to retain the very ace being played.
quotes: The defenders have won this heart trick; retain the heart ace and king for control.

findings.fact: North’s H4 was played on the preceding trick; North is now void in hearts and selects D7.
findings.explanation: The reason invents an available H4 and instructs a different suit and card from the actual selection.
quotes: Dummy should follow with its last heart, the four.
